source_documents.title: Contribution of radiative rate constants to crystallization-induced emission enhancement in boron-fused azobenzene complexes

reference_evidence_units.quote: moderate isolated yields (34% for BAz-F and 38% for BAz-Cl)
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA at room temperature; crystals versus 10^-5 M vitrified 2MeTHF and toluene/2-methylpentane 1:9 at 77 K.
reference_evidence_units.statement: BAz-Cl is explicitly the chlorinated boron-fused azobenzene derivative synthesized in Scheme 1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Synthetic isolated yield is not emission quantum yield; graph confirmation deferred.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Comparison of (c) absolute FL quantum yield, (d) radiative rate constant, and (e) nonradiative rate constant between 1 wt% PMMA ﬁlms and crystals
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA at room temperature; crystals versus 10^-5 M vitrified 2MeTHF and toluene/2-methylpentane 1:9 at 77 K.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Figure 2 labels BAz-Cl room-temperature quantum yields 1.5%/12%, kr 0.20/1.3 x10^8 s^-1 and knr 13/10 x10^8 s^-1 for PMMA/crystal.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Figure 2 visually inspected; these are plotted values, not text-inferred values from BAz-F or BAz-Br.

reference_evidence_units.quote: restriction of structural relaxation in the excited state
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA at room temperature; crystals versus 10^-5 M vitrified 2MeTHF and toluene/2-methylpentane 1:9 at 77 K.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The series' crystal contacts are proposed to restrict structural relaxation and aid fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Shared interpretation across the series; no individual contact energy or motion amplitude quantified here.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Comparison of (b) absolute FL quantum yield, (c) radiative rate constant, and (d) nonradiative rate constant
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA at room temperature; crystals versus 10^-5 M vitrified 2MeTHF and toluene/2-methylpentane 1:9 at 77 K.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Figure 3 labels BAz-Cl 77 K quantum yields 55%, 59%, 34%, kr 1.1, 1.0, 1.7 and knr 0.92, 0.73, 3.2 x10^8 s^-1 for 2MeTHF, Tol/2MP, crystal respectively.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Figure 3 visually inspected. Crystal kr increases but total yield falls because knr increases; do not transfer BAz-F's 77 K yield enhancement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: kr values of BAz-Cl and BAz-Br showed the opposite tendency.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA at room temperature; crystals versus 10^-5 M vitrified 2MeTHF and toluene/2-methylpentane 1:9 at 77 K.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Changing glass solvent from 2MeTHF to Tol/2MP lowers BAz-Cl kr, unlike BAz-H/F.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The source suggests possible solvent interaction with boron, but does not establish a binding/coordination equilibrium.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the observed increase in kr for haloge- nated BAz derivatives should mainly originate from the higher polarizability in the crystal surrounding
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA at room temperature; crystals versus 10^-5 M vitrified 2MeTHF and toluene/2-methylpentane 1:9 at 77 K.
reference_evidence_units.statement: For halogenated targets the authors favor crystal polarizability over J-coupling or planarization as the main reason for radiative acceleration.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Series interpretation tested with approximate refractive-index and dimer models.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 2.03 for BAz-F, 2.19 for BAz-Cl, and 2.30 for BAz-Br
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA at room temperature; crystals versus 10^-5 M vitrified 2MeTHF and toluene/2-methylpentane 1:9 at 77 K.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The Lorentz-Lorenz estimate gives BAz-Cl crystal refractive index 2.19, versus calculated glass 1.53; Strickler-Berg analysis connects n^2 to kr.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Calculated, not directly measured refractive indices; model details are in uninspected SI.

reference_evidence_units.quote: ISC should be induced by the external heavy atom eﬀect associated with the multiple molecules in crystal.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA at room temperature; crystals versus 10^-5 M vitrified 2MeTHF and toluene/2-methylpentane 1:9 at 77 K.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors propose external heavy-atom-induced ISC as the extra crystal nonradiative channel in BAz-Cl/Br; nearly unchanged computed SOC argues against an internal heavy-atom cause.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Tentative external-heavy-atom attribution, not measured ISC kinetics; approximately 10 cm^-1 SOC is a source calculation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: phosphorescence was not detected at 77 K
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-Cl
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal versus 1 wt% PMMA at room temperature; crystals versus 10^-5 M vitrified 2MeTHF and toluene/2-methylpentane 1:9 at 77 K.
reference_evidence_units.statement: No phosphorescence was detected at 77 K; proposed triplet population is therefore assigned a nonradiative fate.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Absence of detectable phosphorescence is not proof of absent triplets or proof of the proposed ISC route.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain the source's explicit contact-mediated structural-relaxation restriction as a room-temperature contribution, not as the sole low-temperature mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystal contacts constrain relaxation and the surrounding medium changes polarizability; these are distinct from a cavity host-guest mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Radiative acceleration associated with crystal polarizability is central, while a larger knr offsets it at 77 K.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve the explicitly proposed external heavy-atom ISC loss pathway with its tentative status and lack of detected phosphorescence.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Retain the source's explicit contact-mediated structural-relaxation restriction as a room-temperature contribution, not as the sole low-temperature mechanism.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Crystal contacts constrain relaxation and the surrounding medium changes polarizability; these are distinct from a cavity host-guest mechanism.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Solvent-dependent rates raise a coordination possibility but do not establish a target binding mechanism.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific CT or TICT mechanism is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific excited-state proton-transfer pathway is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on is established; energy transfer and CT character are not by themselves PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: H-like dimers have weak calculated coupling and are not identified as the main cause of the BAz-Cl kr increase; no positive J/excimer assignment.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Radiative acceleration associated with crystal polarizability is central, while a larger knr offsets it at 77 K.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Preserve the explicitly proposed external heavy-atom ISC loss pathway with its tentative status and lack of detected phosphorescence.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection mechanism is established; rotation restriction alone does not prove CI access.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-singlet-state emission or anti-Kasha mechanism is established; higher-state absorption alone is insufficient.
